name: SL18 Beta WAF Rules
description: Web Application Firewall ruleset for beta.waliinstudio.com - SQLi, XSS, and bot mitigation

rules.name: Block SQL Keywords in Parameters
rules.description: Detect common SQL injection keywords in query parameters
rules.expression: (http.request.uri.query contains "UNION" or http.request.uri.query contains "SELECT" or http.request.uri.query contains "INSERT" or http.request.uri.query contains "UPDATE" or http.request.uri.query contains "DELETE" or http.request.uri.query contains "DROP") and not cf.bot_management.verified_bot

rules.name: Block SQL Comment Injection
rules.description: Detect SQL comment patterns used in injection attacks
rules.expression: (http.request.uri.query contains "--" or http.request.uri.query contains "/*" or http.request.uri.query contains "*/") and not cf.bot_management.verified_bot

rules.name: Block SQL Injection in Body
rules.description: Detect SQL injection attempts in request body
rules.expression: (http.request.body.raw contains "' OR '" or http.request.body.raw contains "1=1" or http.request.body.raw contains "' OR 1=1" or http.request.body.raw contains "'; DROP") and http.request.method in {"POST" "PUT" "PATCH"}

rules.name: Block Encoded SQL Injection
rules.description: Detect URL-encoded SQL injection attempts
rules.expression: (http.request.uri.query contains "%27" or http.request.uri.query contains "%22" or http.request.uri.query contains "%3B") and (http.request.uri.query contains "union" or http.request.uri.query contains "select")

rules.name: Block Script Tags
rules.description: Detect script tag injection attempts
rules.expression: (http.request.uri.query contains "<script" or http.request.uri.query contains "</script>" or http.request.body.raw contains "<script" or http.request.body.raw contains "</script>")

rules.name: Block Event Handlers
rules.description: Detect inline event handler injection
rules.expression: (http.request.uri.query matches "on(load|error|click|mouseover|focus|blur|submit)\s*=" or http.request.body.raw matches "on(load|error|click|mouseover|focus|blur|submit)\s*=")

rules.name: Block JavaScript Protocol
rules.description: Detect javascript: protocol injection
rules.expression: (http.request.uri.query contains "javascript:" or http.request.body.raw contains "javascript:" or http.request.uri.query contains "vbscript:")

rules.name: Block Data URI XSS
rules.description: Detect data URI based XSS attempts
rules.expression: (http.request.uri.query contains "data:text/html" or http.request.body.raw contains "data:text/html")

rules.name: Block SVG XSS
rules.description: Detect SVG-based XSS attempts
rules.expression: (http.request.uri.query contains "<svg" and http.request.uri.query contains "onload") or (http.request.body.raw contains "<svg" and http.request.body.raw contains "onload")

rules.name: Block Known Bad Bots
rules.description: Block requests from known malicious bot user agents
rules.expression: (http.user_agent contains "sqlmap" or http.user_agent contains "nikto" or http.user_agent contains "nmap" or http.user_agent contains "masscan" or http.user_agent contains "zgrab" or http.user_agent contains "nuclei")

rules.name: Challenge Empty User Agents
rules.description: Challenge requests with empty or missing user agents
rules.expression: (http.user_agent eq "" or not http.user_agent) and not cf.bot_management.verified_bot

rules.name: Challenge Automated Tools
rules.description: Challenge requests from common automation tools
rules.expression: (http.user_agent contains "curl" or http.user_agent contains "wget" or http.user_agent contains "python-requests" or http.user_agent contains "axios" or http.user_agent contains "node-fetch") and not any(http.request.headers["x-api-key"][*] ne "")

rules.name: Block Headless Browsers
rules.description: Detect and block headless browser patterns
rules.expression: (http.user_agent contains "HeadlessChrome" or http.user_agent contains "PhantomJS" or http.user_agent contains "Selenium")

rules.name: Rate Limit Suspicious IPs
rules.description: Apply rate limiting to IPs showing bot-like behavior
rules.expression: cf.threat_score gt 30

rules.name: Login Rate Limit
rules.description: Limit login attempts to prevent brute force
rules.expression: http.request.uri.path eq "/api/auth/login" and http.request.method eq "POST"

rules.name: Signup Rate Limit
rules.description: Limit signup attempts to prevent abuse
rules.expression: http.request.uri.path eq "/api/auth/signup" and http.request.method eq "POST"

rules.name: Token Redemption Rate Limit
rules.description: Limit invite token redemption attempts
rules.expression: http.request.uri.path eq "/api/invite/redeem" and http.request.method eq "POST"

rules.name: API Rate Limit
rules.description: General API rate limiting
rules.expression: http.request.uri.path starts_with "/api/" and http.request.method in {"GET" "POST" "PUT" "PATCH" "DELETE"}

rules.name: Password Reset Rate Limit
rules.description: Limit password reset requests
rules.expression: http.request.uri.path eq "/api/auth/reset-password" and http.request.method eq "POST"

rules.name: Block Directory Traversal
rules.description: Detect and block directory traversal attempts
rules.expression: (http.request.uri.path contains ".." or http.request.uri.query contains ".." or http.request.uri.path contains "%2e%2e")

rules.name: Block Sensitive File Access
rules.description: Block attempts to access sensitive files
rules.expression: (http.request.uri.path contains ".env" or http.request.uri.path contains ".git" or http.request.uri.path contains "wp-config" or http.request.uri.path contains ".htaccess" or http.request.uri.path contains "web.config")

rules.name: Block Oversized Requests
rules.description: Block requests with excessive body size
rules.expression: http.request.body.size gt 10485760

rules.name: Block Invalid Content Types
rules.description: Block requests with suspicious content types
rules.expression: http.request.method in {"POST" "PUT" "PATCH"} and not any(http.request.headers["content-type"][*] matches "(application/json|application/x-www-form-urlencoded|multipart/form-data)")

rules.name: Block HTTP Request Smuggling
rules.description: Detect HTTP request smuggling attempts
rules.expression: (any(http.request.headers["transfer-encoding"][*] contains "chunked") and any(http.request.headers["content-length"][*] ne ""))

rules.name: Challenge High-Risk Countries
rules.description: Additional challenge for high-risk geographic regions
rules.expression: ip.geoip.country in {"XX" "YY"}
rules.notes: Enable and configure country codes as needed

bypass_rules.name: Bypass for Health Checks
bypass_rules.expression: http.request.uri.path eq "/health" or http.request.uri.path eq "/ready" or http.request.uri.path eq "/live"

bypass_rules.name: Bypass for Internal IPs
bypass_rules.description: Skip WAF for internal monitoring IPs
